notes: CRM notes: mid-market product analytics company building a contextual support assistant + semantic search. Started on Hosted API to validate model/quality, now moving to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Procurement reached — MSA and DPA redlines in flight. Legal quote: "we need clear SLA credits and staff escalation matrix". Key ask from platform team: VPC-only dedicated deployment with ability to access KMS, audit logs, and regional data residency for EU customers. POC success metrics: reply accuracy >= baseline on intent match, embeddings cosine threshold >= 0.75, p95 latency < 60ms for chat. Cost sensitivity moderate — they expect 20-30% cost reduction vs hosted at scale via batching/quantization. SE notes: will require canary rollout plan and traffic shaping. CSM asked to prepare onboarding checklist: account creation, SSO, network allowlist, KMS key exchange, support SLAs. Procurement flagged vendor security questionnaire (completed except for pen-test report).
sla_requirements: Target 99.9% uptime for Dedicated control plane and 95th/99th percentile latency targets for production chat (p95 < 60ms, p99 < 250ms). Request explicit maintenance window notification 72h and SLA credits formula; require operations escalation contact and playbook.
legal_status: MSA draft received from Trellis legal; Redwood received redlines 2026-02-20. Major redlines: updated SLA credits, liability cap language, DPA retention terms, EU data residency addendum requested.
procurement_feedback: Procurement wants SSO/SAML integration walkthrough, SOC2 Type II evidence, and confirmation that audit logs are exportable to their SIEM. Also asked for a short whitepaper on Dedicated VPC networking and onboarding steps.
technical_requirements_summary: Use-case: multi-tenant support assistant and document reranking. Throughput: sustained 120 reqs/minute during business hours, spikes up to 450 rpm. Latency target p95 < 60ms. Model preference: open LLM family with an option to pin to a quantized 8-bit variant for cost. Need KV cache persistence across nodes and predictable cold-start behavior.
